svg.title: pytest-bluezenv overview
svg.desc: A pytest process on the developer machine drives several QEMU VM hosts over RPC. Each VM runs bluetoothd on top of the kernel under test; the kernel reaches its own Bluetooth controller over HCI. With btvirt the controllers are emulated and bridged by a virtual air link, so the VM hosts see each other; a real USB/PCIe controller may be passed through instead.
